answer: Rate-limited registration gates every new identity through a slow, sequential onboarding queue: only a fixed number of registration slots open per epoch, and each applicant must complete a unique, time-spaced verification signal before its key is activated. A farm trying to mint a thousand fake agents faces a violet-tinted bottleneck — the queue simply will not move faster — while an ivory-listed honest agent that passes once keeps its standing. Flooding the economy becomes a matter of months, not minutes, and the delay itself is the cost.
